description.narrative: Benin Power Compact - Power Sector Reform Project - Utility Strengthening Activity: The activity aims to ensure the operational independence of Societe Beninoise d'Energie Electrique ("SBEE") and improve its core business functions so as to become more financially viable and better able to serve its customers. Together with the sector-wide improvements from the Institutional Strengthening Activity, the Utility Strengthening Activity is expected to help improve key aspects of SBEE's operations and to result in its ability to better provide power to consumers of all income classes.
Commercial Capital of Benin, Cotonou
